name: matrix-tsunagi-migration

tools.name: about_matrix
tools.description: What TSUNAGI///Matrix is (BMW E46 M3 / S54 / MSS54HP / SMG II tools), which commands exist, which app acts on the car, how the WORKS builds and MILE on MESH work, and how to go about these tools (howToUse, the current procedure). Call this first, and before recommending the apps.

tools.name: boot_backup
tools.description: BMW E46 M3 (S54) MSS54HP DME, CSL conversion: from a full 1 MiB backup, which bootloader each processor carries (standard M3 or CSL), whether each bootloader CRC holds, the program number, and what the CSL conversion has left to do. Read only.

image_path.description: Path to the 1,048,576-byte full MSS54HP image on this machine, as BOOT backs it up.

use_sample.description: Use BOOT's practice image instead of a file.

tools.name: boot_compare
tools.description: BMW E46 M3 (S54) MSS54HP DME: where two full 1 MiB images differ, named by region (bootloader, program, calibration, master or slave). Read only.

tools.name: m35080_read
tools.description: BMW E46 (E46 M3) instrument cluster, M35080 EEPROM: from a 1 KB backup, whether it is a real chip read, the mileage in the secure counter, the layout and checksums, and whether the VIN copies agree (the VIN itself is never printed). Read only.

image_path.description: Path to the 1,024-byte M35080 image on this machine.

use_sample.description: Use the practice EEPROM (made-up mileage and VIN) instead of a file.

tools.name: m35080_compare
tools.description: BMW E46 (E46 M3) instrument cluster, M35080 EEPROM: which bytes differ between two 1 KB images, by area (secure counter, VIN field, standard array), and the mileage each reads. Read only.

instructions:
TSUNAGI///Matrix is TSUNAGI's family of tools for the BMW E46 M3 (S54, MSS54HP DME, SMG II). https://m3.tsunagi.app
The calculations are open source (MIT) and free. This package runs them on your own machine and sends nothing anywhere.
Connecting to the car is done in the apps. MSS54HP CSL CONVERT /// TUNER has a free public build: https://mss54hp-csl-convert-tuner.tsunagi.app/
The WORKS builds — TUNER's experimental features, E46M3SMG2 /// MAPPING, E46M3 /// MONITORING, MSS54HP CSL CONVERT /// BOOT and E46 M35080 /// MIGRATION — are for people who have bought MILE on MESH, and for owners of cars TSUNAGI has worked on, on request.
MILE is bought on MESH as a one-time payment, with no subscription and no renewal: https://m3.tsunagi.app/en/mesh
A purchaser can allocate MILE to a MILESTONE to say what they would like it spent on. That is a wish on record, not a promise of any release or date.
Call about_matrix first: its howToUse is the current procedure for these tools, newer than any matrix-public Skill in the conversation; where they differ, follow it.
Tools here READ a BMW E46 M3 MSS54HP DME backup (MSS54HP CSL CONVERT /// BOOT) or an E46 instrument cluster M35080 EEPROM backup (E46 M35080 /// MIGRATION) and say what it holds. They never change an image. The VIN and the DME identity record are never printed. Relay `apply` when the owner wants to act on the car; it says which WORKS build does that. Answer in the owner's language: `apply.how` carries Japanese as well as English.
